Name: How do I reset my password?
Content: Go to Settings > Security > Reset Password. You'll receive an email with a reset link, valid for 24 hours.

Name: How do I change my email address?
Content: Go to Settings > Account > Email, enter the new address, and confirm via the verification link sent to it.

Name: How do I delete my account?
Content: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. This is permanent and removes all your data after a 14-day grace period.

Name: Can I have multiple users on one account?
Content: Yes, Team and Business plans support multiple users. Go to Settings > Team to invite members.

Name: How do I change my username?
Content: Go to Settings > Profile > Username. Usernames can be changed once every 30 days.

Name: I didn't receive my verification email, what should I do?
Content: Check your spam folder first. If it's not there, click 'Resend verification email' on the login page. Emails can take up to 10 minutes to arrive.

Name: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
Content: Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and follow the setup instructions using an authenticator app.

Name: Can I merge two accounts?
Content: We don't support automatic account merging, but our support team can manually transfer data between accounts on request.

Name: How do I update my profile picture?
Content: Go to Settings > Profile > Photo and upload a new image. Supported formats are JPG and PNG, up to 5MB.

Name: What happens to my data if I cancel my account?
Content: Your data is retained for 30 days after cancellation in case you want to reactivate, then permanently deleted.

Name: How do I change my account's time zone?
Content: Go to Settings > Preferences > Time Zone and select your local time zone from the dropdown.

Name: Can I use the same email for two accounts?
Content: No, each email address can only be linked to one account. Use a different email or delete the existing account first.

Name: How do I log out of all devices?
Content: Go to Settings > Security > Active Sessions and click 'Log out of all devices'.

Name: Why is my account locked?
Content: Accounts are temporarily locked after 5 failed login attempts for security. Wait 15 minutes or reset your password to unlock it.

Name: How do I transfer account ownership?
Content: Go to Settings > Team > Ownership Transfer. Only the current owner can initiate this, and the new owner must accept via email.

Name: What's your refund policy?
Content: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase, processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

Name: How do I cancel my subscription?
Content: Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel Plan. Your access continues until the end of the current billing period.

Name: Do you offer a free trial?
Content: Yes, all new accounts get a 14-day free trial with full feature access, no credit card required.

Name: What payment methods do you accept?
Content: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and for annual plans, bank transfer on request.

Name: How do I update my payment method?
Content: Go to Settings > Billing > Payment Method and enter your new card details.

Name: Why was I charged twice this month?
Content: This usually happens if you upgraded mid-cycle, which triggers a prorated charge alongside the regular renewal. Check your invoice history for details.

Name: Do you offer discounts for annual billing?
Content: Yes, annual plans include a 20% discount compared to monthly billing.

Name: Can I get an invoice for my purchase?
Content: Yes, invoices are automatically emailed after each payment and are also available under Settings > Billing > Invoices.

Name: What happens if my payment fails?
Content: We'll retry the payment 3 times over 7 days. If it still fails, your account is downgraded to the free plan until payment is updated.

Name: Do you offer student or nonprofit discounts?
Content: Yes, we offer 50% off for verified students and registered nonprofits. Apply through Settings > Billing > Discounts.

Name: Can I downgrade my plan mid-cycle?
Content: Yes, downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle, and you keep current features until then.

Name: Is there a setup fee?
Content: No, there are no setup fees on any plan.

Name: How do I add a VAT/tax ID to my invoice?
Content: Go to Settings > Billing > Tax Information and enter your VAT or tax ID before your next billing cycle.

Name: What currency am I billed in?
Content: Billing currency is determined by your account's country setting at signup and shown at checkout.

Name: Can I pause my subscription instead of cancelling?
Content: Yes, Business plans support a 3-month pause option. Go to Settings > Billing > Pause Subscription.

Name: Do you ship internationally?
Content: Yes, we ship to over 40 countries. International orders take 7-14 business days.

Name: Can I change my order after placing it?
Content: Orders can be modified within 1 hour of placing them by contacting support. After that, the order is locked for processing.

Name: How much does shipping cost?
Content: Domestic shipping is free on orders over $50; otherwise it's a flat $5.99. International rates vary by destination and are shown at checkout.

Name: How do I track my order?
Content: You'll receive a tracking link by email once your order ships. You can also find it under Orders > Order History.

Name: What if my package arrives damaged?
Content: Contact support within 7 days of delivery with photos of the damage, and we'll send a free replacement.

Name: Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
Content: Yes, if the order hasn't shipped yet. Contact support immediately with your new address.

Name: Do you offer express shipping?
Content: Yes, express shipping (2-3 business days) is available at checkout for an additional fee.

Name: What happens if my package is lost?
Content: If tracking shows no movement for 10+ business days, contact support and we'll investigate or send a replacement.

Name: Do you ship to PO boxes?
Content: Yes, standard shipping supports PO boxes. Express shipping requires a physical address.

Name: Can I combine multiple orders into one shipment?
Content: Orders placed within 24 hours of each other can sometimes be combined — contact support before the first order ships to request this.

Name: The app keeps crashing, what should I do?
Content: Try updating to the latest version first. If it still crashes, clear the app cache in Settings > Storage, or reinstall the app.

Name: Why can't I log in even with the correct password?
Content: This can happen if your account is locked after failed attempts, or if there's a temporary service outage. Check our status page or try resetting your password.

Name: The page won't load, what should I check?
Content: Try refreshing, clearing your browser cache, or switching browsers. If the issue persists across devices, check our status page for outages.

Name: Do you have a mobile app?
Content: Yes, our app is available on iOS and Android. Search for our name in the App Store or Google Play.

Name: Why are my changes not saving?
Content: This is often caused by an unstable internet connection. Check your connection and try again; unsaved drafts are auto-saved locally for up to 24 hours.

Name: How do I clear my cache?
Content: In most browsers: Settings > Privacy > Clear Browsing Data > select 'Cached images and files'.

Name: Is there a dark mode?
Content: Yes, go to Settings > Appearance > Theme and select Dark Mode.

Name: Why is the app running slowly?
Content: Try closing other open tabs or apps, and ensure you're on the latest version. Large datasets can also slow performance — try filtering your view.

Name: Can I use the platform offline?
Content: Limited offline functionality is available in the mobile app; changes sync automatically once you're back online.

Name: What browsers are supported?
Content: We support the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Internet Explorer is not supported.

Name: How do I export my data?
Content: Go to Settings > Data > Export. You can export as CSV, JSON, or PDF depending on the data type.

Name: Why did I get logged out unexpectedly?
Content: Sessions expire after 30 days of inactivity, or if you log in from a new device that triggers a security check.

Name: Can I recover a deleted file?
Content: Deleted files go to Trash and remain recoverable for 30 days. Go to Trash > Restore.

Name: How do I report a bug?
Content: Go to Help > Report a Bug, or email support with a screenshot and description of the issue.

Name: Why am I seeing an error code when uploading files?
Content: This usually means the file exceeds our 25MB limit or is an unsupported format. Check Settings > Storage for accepted file types.

Name: Is my data encrypted?
Content: Yes, all data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest using AES-256.

Name: Do you sell my data to third parties?
Content: No, we never sell customer data. See our Privacy Policy for full details on data usage.

Name: How do I report a security vulnerability?
Content: Email our security team directly at security@ourcompany.com. We run a responsible disclosure program with rewards for verified reports.

Name: Is my payment information stored on your servers?
Content: No, payment details are handled entirely by our PCI-compliant payment processor and never stored on our servers.

Name: Can I see who has accessed my account?
Content: Yes, go to Settings > Security > Login History to see recent access by device, location, and time.

Name: Do you comply with GDPR?
Content: Yes, we are fully GDPR compliant. You can request data export or deletion at any time under Settings > Privacy.

Name: What happens if I suspect unauthorized access?
Content: Immediately change your password and enable two-factor authentication. Contact support to review your account's access logs.

Name: Are backups encrypted?
Content: Yes, all backups are encrypted with the same AES-256 standard as live data.

Name: Can I restrict login to specific IP addresses?
Content: Yes, this is available on Business and Enterprise plans under Settings > Security > IP Allowlist.

Name: How often do you run security audits?
Content: We conduct third-party security audits twice a year and continuous automated vulnerability scanning.

Name: Do you integrate with Slack?
Content: Yes, go to Settings > Integrations > Slack to connect your workspace and receive notifications.

Name: Can I connect this to Zapier?
Content: Yes, we have an official Zapier integration supporting most triggers and actions. Search for our app name in Zapier's app directory.

Name: Do you have an API?
Content: Yes, our REST API is available on Business and Enterprise plans. Documentation is at docs.ourcompany.com/api.

Name: Can I integrate with Google Calendar?
Content: Yes, go to Settings > Integrations > Calendar and authorize access to sync events automatically.

Name: Do you support webhooks?
Content: Yes, webhooks can be configured under Settings > Integrations > Webhooks for real-time event notifications.

Name: Is there a Chrome extension?
Content: Yes, available on the Chrome Web Store — search for our app name.

Name: Can I connect Salesforce?
Content: Yes, our Salesforce integration is available on Enterprise plans. Contact sales to enable it.

Name: Do you support single sign-on (SSO)?
Content: Yes, SAML-based SSO is available on Enterprise plans under Settings > Security > SSO.

Name: Can I export data directly to Google Sheets?
Content: Yes, use our Google Sheets integration under Settings > Integrations, or connect via Zapier.

Name: Is there a Microsoft Teams integration?
Content: Yes, go to Settings > Integrations > Microsoft Teams to connect and receive channel notifications.

Name: What plans do you offer?
Content: We offer Free, Pro, Team, and Business plans, each with increasing storage, users, and feature limits. See our Pricing page for full details.

Name: What's the difference between Pro and Team plans?
Content: Pro is for individuals with full feature access; Team adds multi-user collaboration, shared workspaces, and admin controls.

Name: Can I switch plans at any time?
Content: Yes, upgrades apply immediately; downgrades apply at the next billing cycle.

Name: Is there a limit on storage?
Content: Free plans include 2GB, Pro includes 50GB, and Team/Business plans include 250GB+ with add-on options.

Name: Do you offer a lifetime plan?
Content: We don't currently offer lifetime plans; all plans are subscription-based.

Name: What happens when I hit my storage limit?
Content: You'll receive a warning at 90% usage. Once full, uploads are paused until you free up space or upgrade.

Name: Can I try Business features before upgrading?
Content: Yes, you can request a 14-day Business trial from Settings > Billing > Request Trial.

Name: Is customer support included in all plans?
Content: Email support is included in all plans; Team and Business plans also include live chat support.

Name: Do you offer enterprise custom pricing?
Content: Yes, for teams over 50 users, contact sales for custom Enterprise pricing.

Name: What's included in the free plan?
Content: The free plan includes core features with limited storage (2GB) and up to 1 user, no time limit.

Name: Can nonprofits get a custom plan?
Content: Yes, verified nonprofits can apply for discounted Team plans through Settings > Billing > Discounts.

Name: How many projects can I create on the Pro plan?
Content: Pro plans support unlimited projects; the Free plan is limited to 3 active projects.

Name: Do unused features roll over if I don't use them?
Content: No, plan limits (like storage or seats) reset each billing cycle and don't roll over.

Name: Can I add extra seats to my Team plan?
Content: Yes, additional seats can be purchased anytime under Settings > Billing > Add Seats.

Name: Is there a mobile-only plan?
Content: No, all plans include full access across web, desktop, and mobile at the same price.

Name: What are your support hours?
Content: Email support is available 24/7 with a typical response time under 4 hours. Live chat is available Monday-Friday, 9am-6pm EST.

Name: How do I contact sales?
Content: Email sales@ourcompany.com or use the 'Contact Sales' form on our Pricing page.

Name: Do you have a status page for outages?
Content: Yes, check status.ourcompany.com for real-time uptime and incident updates.

Name: Where can I find your terms of service?
Content: Our Terms of Service are available at ourcompany.com/terms and linked in the footer of every page.

Name: Do you offer onboarding help for new teams?
Content: Yes, Team and Business plans include a free 30-minute onboarding call with our customer success team.

Name: How do I suggest a new feature?
Content: Submit ideas through Help > Feature Requests, or vote on existing suggestions from other users.

Name: Is there a community forum?
Content: Yes, join our community at community.ourcompany.com to ask questions and share tips with other users.

Name: Do you have a changelog?
Content: Yes, recent updates and releases are listed at ourcompany.com/changelog.

Name: Can I white-label the platform?
Content: White-labeling is available on Enterprise plans. Contact sales to discuss options.

Name: How do I close a support ticket?
Content: Tickets auto-close after 7 days of inactivity, or you can close it manually from Help > My Tickets.
